scope: One virtual long-only mainland CS account, T+1 holdings, no leverage, no initial holdings, no delayed deposits or withdrawals, gross dividend research only; no dividend withholding or later tax levy
cash_owner: CashAccount extends pinned native RQAlpha Account; superclass alone changes total cash, order reservation and positions
state: Unspent net sale receipts with an AD-admitted next session, applied execution identities and completed native lifecycle phases; these restrict existing cash and are not a second cash balance
withdrawable_formula: max(0, min(native total_cash - pending unspent net sale receipts, native cash))
spend_policy: Buys reuse already-received unsettled sale proceeds first, FIFO. A later sale does not retrospectively refinance an earlier purchase. Reservations use unsettled proceeds first without consuming receipts until filled.
settlement: Release restriction during next admitted session PRE_BEFORE_TRADING, before strategy before_trading; never at the sale session final callback or because wall-clock date changed
dividends: Native gross receivable/payment accounting; explicit execution model must separately authorize qualification, tax and PRE_BEFORE_TRADING posting. A payment credited there is treated as settled cash by this virtual account model.
cash_transfers: Immediate virtual deposits are settled; virtual withdrawals are bounded by transferable_cash and native order reservations. No real bank or broker operation.

external_support.supports: Broker FAQ says stock-sale cash is not withdrawable on sale day and is withdrawable T+1
external_support.does_not_support: AQ intraday receipt-spending priority, JQ field timing, historical 2024 account behavior or real bank withdrawal permission

jq_equivalence: NOT_VERIFIED; sequential spending priority and lifecycle clock are declared AQ model choices, not exchange-wide rules or measured JQ behavior
restart: Cash restrictions, execution identities and lifecycle phases serialize with native account state; restored model identity required. Complete event cursor and native broker/portfolio/matcher state must still be committed atomically.
orphan_reservation_repair: When no native open orders remain, normalize only a nonzero frozen-cash remainder bounded by both eight ULPs of total_cash and 1e-9 CNY. Never forgive a real-cent reservation or a live order. Lifecycle/accepted-transfer path updates the one native reservation; read projections do not round cash.
